proof_summary: Induct backward along a finite Collatz trajectory to 1, using composability of encoded paths to extend a representation of each parent to the appropriate child. For even \(m\), doubling the parent \(m/2\) recovers \(m\); for odd \(m\ne1\), the parent \(3m+1\) is a branching node whose inverse tripling child is \(m\), with \(1\) as the base case.
